column1: # Modules that carry no behavior row, and why.
# `conformance/modules.toml` lists every source module at the pin; this file
# names the ones the ledger cannot speak for. A module lands here when the pin
# ships no test that covers it, which is the only reason `inventory.sh` can
# leave a module without rows. A `barrel` is an `index.ts` re-export whose
# `conformance/tracker-audit.py` fails when a module has no rows and is not
# listed here, when a listed module gains or loses rows, and when a reason is
# blank or is not `barrel`/`no-test`. So the list is a scope statement with
# teeth: it cannot silently grow or hide a module that a test appears for.
# Two things this file deliberately does not claim: whether a Rust carrier
# exists (a module can be implemented and still unverifiable, because there is
# no pin test to carry its rows), and whether the module is in the ported unit
# at all. `packages/effect/src/internal/` is outside the inventory by
# ADR-0002, which is why its `test/internal/Uuid.test.ts` has no rows and no
# module row to hang them on.
